diff_summary: The teens special case was narrowed from `value % 100 in (11, 12, 13)` to `value % 100 in (11, 12)` -- 13 was dropped from the tuple.
why_its_a_bug: Without 13 in the special case, `value % 10 == 3` takes over and the function returns '13rd' instead of '13th'. The same applies to every number ending in 13 (113, 213, ...).
hint_level_description: 1st, 2nd, 22nd and 11th are all fine. The function handles the awkward teens with an explicit special case -- check whether that case covers everything it should.
